meta.name: product-launch-video
meta.description: Turn a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch / promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos, app and company launches. Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours / showcases of a website route here too — the brief carries the show-it-as-is intent. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据产品链接或脚本自动生成推广视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在几分钟内制作一支产品宣传视频
copy.tagline_en: Generate a promo video from a product URL or script
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick promotional video for your product

howto.what: 装上后，当你提供产品URL、脚本或brief时，Claude会自动生成一个产品发布或宣传视频，包括SaaS宣传、功能演示、产品演示等。它会按步骤执行：初始化项目、捕获资产、设计系统、编写故事板和脚本、生成音频、构建帧并渲染输出视频。
howto.when: 当你想要营销、发布、推广或展示一个产品时，或者你提供一个商业URL时，技能会自动触发。网站导览/展示请求也会被引导到这里。

say.text: 为我们的新产品做个宣传视频
say.note: Claude会开始抓取产品信息并构建视频

say.text: 把这个网站做成产品发布视频
say.note: Claude会捕获网站内容并制作视频

say.text: 基于这段脚本生成产品演示视频
say.note: Claude会直接使用脚本编写故事板并渲染

howto.what_en: When you provide a product URL, pasted script, or brief, Claude automatically creates a product launch or promo video. It runs a multi-step workflow: init project, capture assets, design system, storyboard/script, audio, frame construction, and final render.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product, or when any commercial URL is provided. Site tours/showcases also route here.

say_en.text: Make a promo video for our new product
say_en.note: Claude starts capturing product info and builds the video

say_en.text: Turn this website into a launch video
say_en.note: Claude captures the site and produces the video

say_en.text: Create a product demo from this script
say_en.note: Claude uses the script to storyboard and render
